title: The Will That Vanished
subtitle: A Disappearing Will and Deadly Secrets
summary: When a wealthy, witty patriarch’s will mysteriously vanishes, Byomkesh Bakshi is drawn into a tangled web of family intrigue and hidden motives. With a cast of colorful suspects and a case that defies simple explanation, this mystery promises laughter, suspense, and the ultimate test of Byomkesh’s legendary deductive skills.
